about: Concrete transition graph and exact key interner mutants (MODEL-BASED-PATH-TESTS P1).

mutants.name: paths-fingerprint-is-identity
mutants.rule: KeyTable uses the hash only to locate a dense bucket; exact canonical wire-key byte equality decides identity even under hash collision.

mutants.name: paths-drop-visited-edge
mutants.rule: BuildConcrete records every attempted concrete edge before deduplicating its successor state, preserving cycles and joins.

mutants.name: paths-merge-ignore-reject
mutants.from:
case Reject:
				Continue[S, MachineObs[O]]{Next: s, Obs: MachineObs[O]{Kind: DisReject, Output: None}}
mutants.to:
case Reject:
				Continue[S, MachineObs[O]]{Next: s, Obs: MachineObs[O]{Kind: DisIgnore, Output: None}}
mutants.rule: ConcreteOf preserves Reject distinct from Ignore even though both keep the state unchanged.

mutants.name: paths-keeps-first-parent-only
mutants.rule: Full bounded path enumeration preserves every distinct legal history and repeat loop rather than replacing prefixes with each node's shortest predecessor.

mutants.name: paths-edge-target-dedup
mutants.from:
for eIdx in 0..len(g.Edges) {
		let e = g.Edges[eIdx]
mutants.rule: SelectedEdges covers every concrete edge including parallel inputs, closing edges to seen states, self-loops, and terminal edges rather than deduplicating by destination.

mutants.name: paths-release-only-on-match
mutants.from:
let out = DrivePathSession(start, inputs, open, checkInitial, checkStep)
	publish(out)
mutants.rule: RunPathSession closes its acquired PathSession on every exit (including mismatch and drive failure) before publishing SessionOutcome.

mutants.name: paths-reject-tag-only
mutants.rule: Step comparison checks full typed error payloads rather than only matching presence or variant tag.

mutants.name: paths-credit-on-observe
mutants.rule: An observed mismatch increments checked counts only and never credits matched step or edge counts.
